aircraft._commentFlaps: No aircraft-specific flap detents are configured: airbus-base intentionally does not assert shared Airbus flap notches. Add A320neo V2-specific detents only after vendor documentation or in-sim verification.

aircraftCfg._comment: The A20N designator is only accepted when both the title and creator identify the Microsoft/iniBuilds A320neo V2, preventing legacy Asobo, FlyByWire, and Fenix A320 variants from matching.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only; no Microsoft/iniBuilds-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

controls._comment: The exact-profile trusted adapter exposes 42 guarded actions backed by 32 Microsoft-documented standard events and 23 confirmation fields over 44 standard-SimVar fields. OFF/ON intents, including flight-director and autothrottle-arm toggles, require fresh standard readback; four FCU targets are bounded; each unsatisfied route dispatches at most once without retry and requires newer matching or changed readback. Generic fallback remains disabled and the narrow standard gear/flap fallback stays enabled. These are generic simulator semantics, not an Airbus managed/selected or AP1/AP2 contract. FLC, spoilers, runway turnoff, vendor-private interfaces, and deep systems remain write-disabled.

meta.notes: Dedicated exact-profile page for the Microsoft / iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2 in MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024. The shared trusted adapter exposes 44 standard-SimVar fields, 42 guarded actions, 23 confirmation fields, and 32 unique Microsoft-documented standard events with zero custom subscriptions. It prioritizes generic flight guidance and FCU targets, seven exterior-light outputs, gear, relative flap steps, and parking brake. Every action remains untested pending live validation in both simulator generations.

knownIssues: The exact SimConnect TITLE has not been verified in-sim; matching covers documented product-name and package-identity variants.

The 44 standard-SimVar fields, 42 actions, and 23 confirmation fields remain untested against live A320neo V2 variants in both MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024; a documented standard event can still be ignored or incompletely mirrored by a custom aircraft.
AUTOPILOT_ON and AUTOPILOT_OFF expose only generic simulator master behavior. They cannot select or independently confirm Airbus AP1 versus AP2, so AP1/AP2 channel controls remain excluded.
Flight-director and autothrottle-arm OFF/ON intents share documented toggle events behind fresh readback. Standard state may still differ from the aircraft's internal annunciation or selector state.
Standard FCU mode and target events do not express Airbus managed/selected push-pull semantics. Flight-level-change write control remains excluded even though its standard state is readable.
Exterior-light actions confirm seven standard lamp outputs only. Runway-turnoff write control and Airbus AUTO or multi-position selector semantics remain excluded.
Spoiler state remains read-only; no spoiler, raw-axis, vendor-private, macro, or deep-system writes are enabled.
The cited sources do not define an A320neo V2 LVAR, B-var, InputEvent, or hardware-integration map, and the adapter subscribes to zero custom variables.
Flap detents are intentionally absent until A320neo V2-specific handle mapping is source-backed or verified in-sim.
All active write routes retain untested verification until each supported live variant and simulator generation is validated.
